messages:
Asha: Heads-up — Nimbus Analytics (beta cohort) wants a tightly scoped pilot: embeddings + reranker for recommendations. Procurement is fine but their CFO wants a clear success metric tied to renewal. Flagging as "at-risk-until-success-metric" in Gainsight.
Ben: Noted. What metric do they want? If it's business-facing (CTR lift or query accuracy) we should propose a 30-day POC with clear evaluation steps.
Sam (Nimbus Analytics): Hi team — CFO asked for a 15% improvement in click-through on recommended items or a joint review at day 30 with a renewal conversation. We still want to proceed with onboarding asap.
Claire: We can do a 30-day POC but suggest a 14-day sandbox first to get internal stakeholders comfortable. Proposal: 14-day sandbox (hosted), token cap $1,500, then 16-day pilot with telemetry and A/B evaluation.
Ravi: Infra: can provision a sandbox in eu-west-1 (they asked for EU region). ETA ~2h. Command: ```rb prov sandbox --org nimbus-analytics --env sandbox --region eu-west-1 --model redwood-embed-v2 --tokens 50000 --timebox 14d```
Asha: I'll draft the success criteria doc: (1) baseline CTR, (2) target CTR + evaluation method, (3) cadence for demo & metrics review. Will also upload sample telemetry export (p50/p95 latency, tokens/day).
Ben: Also recommend adding a 3-question micro-survey for internal reviewers post-demo to capture qualitative sentiment and any product asks. Claire, can you run the 30m enablement?
Claire: Yep — I'll run a 30m hands-on session Tue 11am CET. Will include a short prompt kit and an eval checklist.
Sam (Nimbus Analytics): Thank you — EU sandbox works. We'll send baseline CTR numbers by EOD. Appreciate the clear success path.
InfraBot: Sandbox nimbus-sandbox created by ravi at 1799998950 (region eu-west-1, model redwood-embed-v2, token_cap 50000, timebox 14d).
Asha: Draft email to CFO to set expectations — feel free to edit:
``
Subject: Nimbus pilot plan & success metrics
Hi [CFO],
Thanks for the direction. Outline: 14-day sandbox to validate integration, followed by a 16-day pilot with A/B evaluation. Target: 15% CTR uplift measured against your baseline over the pilot window. If we hit the target we'll schedule a renewal review; if not, we'll capture learnings and propose follow-ups.
Regards, Asha (Customer Success)
```
Ben: I'll add a risk note in the handoff doc and mark health as 'at-risk-until-metrics'. Claire will collect micro-survey responses and tag product asks in feedback board.
Asha: Next steps recap: 1) EU sandbox provisioned (Ravi) 2) Claire enablement Tue 11am CET 3) Asha to upload success criteria + telemetry 4) Sam shares baseline CTR 5) post-demo micro-survey (Claire). I'll follow up with a short summary in #customer-success tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
